title.en: Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash: Longer Video, Lower Pricing

excerpt.zh: Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash支持最长15秒视频和多轮对话编辑，谷歌称720p生成价格较上一代降低30%。更新强调参考素材与角色一致性，但快速运动、复杂物理效果及实际制作成本仍需评估。
excerpt.en: Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash adds 15-second video and cuts pricing by 30%. Conversational editing expands control, but quality limits remain.

text.zh: Gemini Omni：更长片段，更低标价
text.en: Gemini Omni: Longer Clips, Lower Listed Pricing

text.zh: 谷歌在2026年11月5日的公告中推出Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash，将原生视频生成与编辑的最长时长从上一代的10秒延长至15秒，并支持在3至15秒之间按秒设置时长。谷歌称，720p视频价格较Omni 1.1降低30%，至每秒0.07美元；该模型通过Gemini API和Gemini for business正式开放。
text.en: Google’s November 5, 2026 announcement introduces Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash, extending native video generation and editing from the previous generation’s 10-second maximum to 15 seconds. Users can select durations from 3 to 15 seconds in one-second increments. Google lists 720p video at $0.07 per second, a 30% reduction from Omni 1.1, and announces general availability through the Gemini API and Gemini for business.

text.zh: 对话编辑与参考一致性
更新强调围绕同一片段进行多轮修改，例如替换产品或背景、调整光照及画面比例。参考素材可结合角色、产品或风格图片、最长3秒的动作片段及音频提示。谷歌称，新版改善了角色、服装、包装文字和场景的一致性，并提升对白、口型同步及连续运镜表现；这些仍属于厂商展示与描述，而非独立评测结论。
text.en: The update emphasizes revising the same clip through successive prompts, including product or background swaps, lighting changes, and aspect-ratio adjustments. References can combine character, product, or style images, motion clips up to three seconds long, and audio cues. Google reports better consistency in characters, garments, packaging text, and scenes, alongside improvements in dialogue, lip-sync, and continuous camera movement. These remain vendor demonstrations and claims, not independent evaluation findings.

text.zh: 对广告和产品内容团队而言，值得关注的不只是单次生成降价，还包括能否减少反复重做。谷歌描述的流程是先以360p或720p起稿，再通过对话调整细节，最后将选中的作品放大至1080p或4K。因此，高分辨率输出不应被理解为原生4K生成；实际节省多少时间与费用，仍取决于可用成片比例和修改次数。
text.en: For advertising and product-content teams, the practical opportunity is not just cheaper generation but potentially fewer complete restarts. Google describes drafting at 360p or 720p, refining details conversationally, and then upscaling selected results to 1080p or 4K. That distinction matters: higher-resolution delivery should not be confused with native 4K generation. Actual time and cost savings will depend on how often results are usable and how many revisions they require.

text.zh: 视频生成仍需验证的边界
text.en: Video Generation Limits Still Need Testing

text.zh: 谷歌承认，快速体育动作、快速剧本变化和复杂物理效果仍在改进。输出带有不可感知的SynthID水印，但水印本身不能证明画面内容真实。所给材料没有提供独立质量基准或完整制作成本对比；上线前，更有价值的检验是用团队自己的素材测试参考还原、连续编辑后的稳定性，以及最终交付成本。
text.en: Google acknowledges ongoing work on fast sports action, rapid script changes, and complex physics. Outputs carry an imperceptible SynthID watermark, but a watermark does not establish that depicted events are real. The supplied material provides neither independent quality benchmarks nor a complete production-cost comparison. Before deployment, teams should test reference fidelity, stability after repeated edits, and final delivery costs using their own assets.
